_readme: Missions, their order and their objectives for CampaignState (autoload). Owned by Fahd.
IDs are lowercase with dots. A mission is mN, an objective is mN.thing. Objective IDs are unique across all missions.
objectives: all required for mission_completed. optional_objectives: can be completed but do not count.
objective_titles: what the console and the rover HUD show for each objective. report: the lines the console's Downlink tab shows once the mission's data is sent.

guidance: per objective, the ordered steps the guidance tracker shows (Guidance, src/levels/guidance.gd). A step: text, label (the name over the highlighted target), target (path:<from the level root>, group:<group>, scan:<target_id>, part:<catalog_id> (the part wherever it is: rack, crate, held, on Kite or seated), kite:<Robot property or child node>[/<child path>]), key (an input action), stuck (shown after 45 s), waypoint (on-screen marker while driving; on foot too when the step has on_foot: true), hint_from (optional, same syntax as target: the live get_hint(rover) text comes from that node instead of the target, while the highlight and waypoint stay on target) and done_when (all must hold: state / not_state (GameState names), holding_part (part type), mounted (socket target), fitted (a catalog id in any of Kite's sockets), near + distance (Kite to the target, m), player_near + distance (the player to the target, m), view (rover camera view), console_section). The current step is the one after the last met step; a step without done_when stays until the objective completes. While Kite is driven, a target with get_hint(rover) shows that text as the step line instead of the step's text (an empty hint falls back to the step text). Guidance never completes objectives. complete_guidance: shown once the mission is complete.
legacy_id: the id the same mission has in docs/examples/MISSIONS.json (the save metadata still uses those).
Wording and order follow game/docs/STORY_SCRIPT.md. New IDs go here; tell the group in the chat.

downlink: the console's Downlink tab for this mission. skip_note (optional: objective + text, a warning shown before the action while that optional objective is not done; it does not block the downlink), objective (enabled once every objective before it is done), action (button text), progress (shown while sending), ready (shown when it can be sent), attachment (optional image under the report).

ending (last mission): event (the dialogue_triggers.json event whose lines play in the closing sequence), lines (fallback id/speaker/text used while dialogue_triggers.json has no line for that event) and next_assignment (shown on the result screen).
checklist: extra lines the console's Mission tab shows under the objectives while the mission is open. They are reminders, not objectives.

missions.title: Wake Kite

objective_titles.m1.workshop_entered: Walk from the lander into the workshop
objective_titles.m1.iris_scanned: Scan IRIS's service panel with the mast camera
objective_titles.m1.kite_docked: Return Kite to the charging pad
objective_titles.m1.inspection_sent: Downlink the inspection from the console

report: IRIS's radio-power module has failed, so the station cannot transmit. Its stored data is intact: fit a replacement module in M2.

m1.workshop_entered.text: Walk to the workshop and in through the bay door
m1.workshop_entered.label: Workshop
m1.workshop_entered.stuck: Follow the marker to the building with the lit bay door. It opens as you walk up; go in past the docked rover.

m1.kite_prepared.text: Pick up the light battery from the parts rack
m1.kite_prepared.label: Light battery
m1.kite_prepared.stuck: The rack is the shelving on the bay's wall. Look at the battery and press E.

m1.kite_prepared.text: Drop the battery into Kite's rear battery socket
m1.kite_prepared.label: Battery socket
m1.kite_prepared.stuck: Walk to Kite's rear, look at the glowing box and press E to let go of the battery over it.

m1.iris_scanned.label: Mission console
m1.iris_scanned.stuck: The console is behind the glass partition, facing the bay. Look at it and press E.

m1.iris_scanned.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console

m1.iris_scanned.label: IRIS
m1.iris_scanned.stuck: Follow the marker. IRIS is about 150 m from the base, past the marker posts.

m1.iris_scanned.text: Hold the crosshair on IRIS's service panel
m1.iris_scanned.label: Service panel
m1.iris_scanned.stuck: Aim at the glowing panel on IRIS's front, below the antenna, and keep still until the scan reaches 100%. Headlights: L.

m1.kite_docked.label: Mission console
m1.kite_docked.stuck: Kite is still out at IRIS. Open the console and press CONTROL KITE to drive it back.

m1.kite_docked.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console
Drive back onto the charging pad and stop
m1.kite_docked.label: Charging pad
m1.kite_docked.stuck: Follow the marker into the bay. The dock hint at the top tells you how far to go; stop when it says Charging.

m1.inspection_sent.label: Mission console
m1.inspection_sent.stuck: Look at the console and press E.
Downlink is the third section in the console's list on the left.
The button is under the Downlink text.

missions.complete_guidance: Mission complete. Open the console to start the next mission.

downlink.ready: The inspection is stored on the console and ready to send to Earth.

missions.title: First Signal

objective_titles.m2.cargo_ordered: Order the cargo delivery from the console's Planning tab
objective_titles.m2.cargo_retrieved: Fetch the cargo crate from the landing zone
objective_titles.m2.module_loaded: Load the radio-power module onto Kite
objective_titles.m2.kite_docked: Return Kite to the charging pad
objective_titles.m2.telemetry_received: Receive IRIS's telemetry at the console
objective_titles.m2.near_sample_collected: Collect the near-site sample by IRIS

report: IRIS is transmitting again and its stored data has arrived. The far-rim field logger is silent, so its record is missing: recover it in M3.

downlink.ready: IRIS is online and in range of the workshop antenna. Its telemetry is ready to receive.

m2.cargo_ordered.label: Mission console
m2.cargo_ordered.stuck: Look at the console and press E.
Planning is the fourth section in the console's list on the left.

m2.cargo_ordered.text: Choose a lander and the manifest, then press Confirm order
m2.cargo_ordered.stuck: The radio-power module must go. Keep the total under the lander's limit; a late arrival puts M3 near nightfall.

m2.cargo_retrieved.label: Mission console
m2.cargo_retrieved.stuck: The crate landed out at the landing zone. Open the console and press CONTROL KITE to fetch it.

m2.cargo_retrieved.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console

m2.cargo_retrieved.label: Landing zone
m2.cargo_retrieved.stuck: Follow the marker east-south-east, away from IRIS. Landers set down a few hundred metres out so their exhaust doesn't blast the outpost.

m2.cargo_retrieved.text: Load the crate onto Kite's cargo mount
m2.cargo_retrieved.label: Cargo crate
m2.cargo_retrieved.stuck: Pull up alongside the crate so Kite's deck is beside it, stop, then press E.

m2.cargo_retrieved.text: Bring the crate home into the bay
m2.cargo_retrieved.label: Bay
m2.cargo_retrieved.stuck: Follow the marker back to the workshop and drive in through the bay door. The crate is unpacked as soon as Kite is inside.

m2.module_loaded.text: Go to the delivery crate beside the charging pad
m2.module_loaded.label: Delivery crate
m2.module_loaded.stuck: Leave the console with Esc and go through the personnel door in the glass partition. The crate is open on the bay floor, east of the pad.

m2.module_loaded.label: Radio-power module
m2.module_loaded.stuck: The module is the heavy box lying in the open crate. Look at it and press E.

m2.module_loaded.text: Mount the module in Kite's cargo socket
m2.module_loaded.label: Cargo socket
m2.module_loaded.stuck: The cargo mount is on Kite's deck. Walk up to it and press E to let go of the module over it.

m2.module_installed.label: Mission console
m2.module_installed.stuck: The module is on Kite. Open the console and press CONTROL KITE to drive out to IRIS.

m2.module_installed.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console
Drive to IRIS and park at its module bay
m2.module_installed.label: IRIS module bay
m2.module_installed.stuck: Follow the marker to IRIS. Park with Kite's cargo mount at the glowing bay, stop, then press E.

m2.kite_docked.label: Mission console
m2.kite_docked.stuck: Kite is still out at IRIS. Open the console and press CONTROL KITE to drive it back.

m2.kite_docked.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console
The sample fell out: drive to it and lift it back into the tray with the claw (R, then click)
m2.kite_docked.label: Spilled sample

m2.kite_docked.text: Drive back onto the charging pad and stop
m2.kite_docked.label: Charging pad
m2.kite_docked.stuck: Follow the marker into the bay. The dock hint at the top tells you how far to go; stop when it says Charging.

m2.telemetry_received.label: Mission console
m2.telemetry_received.stuck: Look at the console and press E.
Downlink is the third section in the console's list on the left.
The button is under the Downlink text.

m2.near_sample_collected.text: Take the near sample by IRIS with sample container S-1 in Kite's storage tray
m2.near_sample_collected.label: Near sample site

missions.complete_guidance: Mission complete. Open the console to start the next mission.

missions.title: Beyond the Rim
checklist: Check the shade marker before the return climb

objective_titles.m3.logger_recovered: Recover Evan's logger from the far rim
objective_titles.m3.thermal_pair_recorded: Record a sun and a shade ground temperature at the far rim
objective_titles.m3.kite_docked: Return Kite to the charging pad
objective_titles.m3.archive_sent: Downlink the archive from the console

report: The field logger's records are in, so the IRIS archive is complete. It ends with the earlier crew's last field entry, logged by Evan.

downlink.ready: The field logger's records are copied to the console. The archive is ready to send to Earth.

m3.logger_recovered.label: Cargo socket
m3.logger_recovered.stuck: Evan's logger needs the cargo mount free. Leave Kite, pick up whatever rides there and put it on the bench or rack.

m3.logger_recovered.text: Drive to the far logger, stop beside it and press E to load it
m3.logger_recovered.label: Far logger
m3.logger_recovered.stuck: Park so Kite's cargo mount is within 1.5 m of the logger, stop, then press E.

m3.thermal_pair_recorded.text: Fit the thermal turret on Kite's arm
m3.thermal_pair_recorded.label: Thermal turret
m3.thermal_pair_recorded.stuck: The thermal turret is on the rack under TOOL TURRETS. Leave Kite, take the turret off Kite's arm and drop the thermal one onto the arm's socket. Kite can come back for it: the logger rides on the cargo mount.

m3.thermal_pair_recorded.text: Within 40 m of Evan's logger, switch to the mast view, aim at sunlit ground and press E; then a shade reading near the logger: try the marker post's shadow or Kite's own
m3.thermal_pair_recorded.label: Far rim
m3.thermal_pair_recorded.stuck: Both readings count within 40 m of the logger. Under a high sun the only shade is beside Kite or the marker post: aim the mast camera at it, within 8 m.

m3.kite_docked.label: Mission console
m3.kite_docked.stuck: Kite is still out at the far rim. Open the console and press CONTROL KITE to drive it back.

m3.kite_docked.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console
Fetch the cargo Kite left where it was recovered
m3.kite_docked.label: Left cargo
m3.kite_docked.stuck: After an emergency recovery the logger stays where Kite stopped. Drive there, stop with the cargo mount beside it and press E.

m3.kite_docked.text: Drive back onto the charging pad and stop
m3.kite_docked.label: Charging pad
m3.kite_docked.stuck: Follow the marker into the bay. The dock hint at the top tells you how far to go; stop when it says Charging.

m3.archive_sent.label: Mission console
m3.archive_sent.stuck: Look at the console and press E.
Downlink is the third section in the console's list on the left.
The button is under the Downlink text.

missions.complete_guidance: Campaign complete. Free play: the workshop and Kite are yours.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: That's Evan's last record, the one he never got to send. He left everything ready for someone to finish. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Kite recovered, IRIS online, archive received. I'm closing the field report. Good work out there.

ending.next_assignment: Next assignment: standing by. Kite waits at the workshop.
